[[Mallyx's Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]] that spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Azure Recurve Bow]].

**[[Imperial Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]

==Unique counterparts==
[[Forgotten Flatbow]], [[Ironwing Flatbow]], [[Stoneherder's Flatbow]], [[Inallay's Hornbow]], and [[Xalnax's Destiny]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
